description: The developer's payout account (Stripe Connect), needed to sell products inside their apps. "status": none | pending | active | restricted, with chargesEnabled / payoutsEnabled. "onboarding_link": a one-time URL the developer opens to verify identity and add a bank account (a human must do it). "dashboard_link": a one-time login URL to the Stripe Express dashboard (payouts, balance). Products stay hidden from players until the status is active.
name: neblla_payments_account
